title: The Family as God’s Design
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The family as God’s design means that family relationships are part of God’s created order and are meant to be governed by His Word. Family is a place for love, instruction, honor, care, discipline, faithfulness, and worship before the Lord.
summary: The family as God’s design means that family relationships are part of God’s created order and are meant to be governed by His Word. Family is a place for love, instruction, honor, care, discipline, faithfulness, and worship before the Lord.
christFocus: Jesus Christ redeems people into the household of God and teaches families to live under His lordship. Earthly family is not ultimate, but it is a meaningful place where God’s truth, love, and discipleship should be practiced.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Family begins with God’s design, not merely social custom. From creation, marriage, parenthood, children, honor, and care are placed under God’s authority.

Scripture gives responsibilities within the family. Husbands, wives, parents, children, and extended family members are called to live with love, faithfulness, honor, instruction, and provision.

Sin deeply affects family life. Homes can become places of selfishness, harshness, neglect, manipulation, abuse, or bitterness. God’s design does not excuse sin; it exposes and corrects it.

Christ brings redemption into family relationships. He calls families to repentance, forgiveness, truth, patient love, and discipleship, while reminding believers that the household of God is their eternal family in Him.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people carry deep wounds from family failure. This doctrine does not pretend every family has reflected God’s design well, but it shows that family still matters to God and must be brought under His healing truth.

It also guards against making family an idol. Earthly family is important, but Christ is Lord over the home, and obedience to God must govern every family relationship.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Bring family life under the lordship of Christ. Honor what God designed, repent where sin has distorted it, seek healing where harm has occurred, and use your place in the family to serve, disciple, protect, and love faithfully.
